versions.changelog:
Initial release of fde-operator-os — an applied AI operator playbook for qualifying and delivering AI opportunities.

- Introduces a structured doctrine for senior FDE, applied AI, and delivery leads to turn messy operational reality into actionable business systems.
- Defines canonical workflow stages with clear artifacts, outputs, and stage-gates from qualification to closed-loop delivery.
- Provides operator-grade templates, routing guidelines, and clear boundaries to avoid scope creep into generic strategy or project summaries.
- Details router and engagement mode behaviors, supporting discovery, pilot, rescue, and asset distillation scenarios.
- Emphasizes first-run and default stance best practices for practical, value-driven AI delivery.
